newsitem.title: USA: Bass group backs IBP /Foodbrands deal.
newsitem.headline: Bass group backs IBP /Foodbrands deal.

text.p: A group including Texas billionaires Lee and Sid Bass said Friday they are backing IBP Inc.'s $23.40 tender offer for Foodbrands America Inc.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group, which holds 818,149 shares or a 6.6 percent stake in Foodbrands, said that it reached an agreement March 25, to tender its shares and vote in favor of the merger.
Last week, IBP, a Dakota City, Neb. meat processor offered to acquire the food service supplier in a deal worth $640 million.
IBP bid $23.40 a share for Foodbrands, for a total of $292 million in cash. The company will assume about $348 million in Foodbrands' debt, under the terms of the offer.
Oklahoma City-based Foodbrands is the leader in the pizza toppings industry. The company also produces custom products including pizza crust, burritos, soups, sauces and stuffed pastas.
